items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Erskine Hawkins had an apartment in there.

ctx.x: Well, that was my apartment first, you know, years back. Don REDMAN was next door to me. He had the

very next apartment to me, and down on the first floor Joe Louis had an apartment. Erskine Hawkins had an apartment in there. Yeah, that was a historical building back there then. Yeah, it was a nice building. I enjoyed it. I remember when Joe Louis fought Billy Conn, I was living in that building at the Polo Grounds back there then.

So I went with Barnet later, and Barnet, when I went with him, he was working at the Park Central Hotel in New York. They used bands upstairs there then, and we were there about two, three months, and then we went out on the road, and we did a few theaters and a few one nighters, but Barnet never would work too long. He -- I guess he had money, and he just didn't care.
